> BETSER helps organisations improve visibility, apply technology wisely, and build systems that create impact across Health Tech, Digital & Applied AI, and Energy & Industrial domains.

## About BETSER
BETSER (Betser Life Pvt. Ltd.) is a technology solutions and implementation company based in Thiruvananthapuram, Kerala, India, with clients across 12+ countries. BETSER operates through its Betser product brand across three verticals.

## Verticals

### Health Tech (Betser Healthcare)
- DDO (Doctors Digital Office) — AI-powered digital clinic for private practitioners
- IHMS (Intelligent Hospital Management System) — unified hospital management
- HMS+ — AI intelligence layer for existing hospital systems
- OnePatientOneDoctor — personal AI health digital twin platform
- Aide — hospital-wide AI neural network connecting 9 departments

### Digital & Applied AI
- Workflow & Process Automation
- AI Agentic Solutions & Knowledge Assistants
- Applied AI for Enterprises
- Custom Development Projects

### Energy & Industrial (Betser Energy)
- Ampris — Electrical SCADA and Grid Orchestration
- Plant Digital Twin — vendor-neutral enterprise intelligence layer
- PIMS — Plant Information and Management System
- FlowNexus — Pipeline Telemetry and Liquid Control
- NexaProc — Enterprise Process Automation and Batch Control
- P&ID Xtract — AI-powered P&ID Digitisation
- PLC Logic Studio — AI PLC Programming and Simulation
- SmartPanel Design — AI-powered Electrical Panel ECAD
